Citibank London Fined for Russia Sanctions Violations

Citibank's London unit has been fined £4.7 million (approximately $6 million USD) by UK authorities for breaching sanctions related to Russia. The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) imposed the penalty for failures in the bank's financial crime systems. These systems were found to be inadequate in monitoring transactions and identifying potential breaches of sanctions against Russia. The fine highlights ongoing regulatory scrutiny of financial institutions' compliance with international sanctions regimes.
